title: Quaint Country Home w/ Pool - 20 Min from Downtown
description: Welcome to Nashville and country living! Located right off of I-24 in Joelton, this quaint, country home has two bedrooms and one bathroom with ample space and amenities for groups and families with kids including a large, in-ground pool & hot tub. The home comfortably sleeps 4, and can accommodate up to 6 with the use of an air mattress. It can be set up in the bedroom or living room floor. The kitchen is stocked with basic cooking supplies, dishes, and a Keurig - there is no dishwasher.
